text: こっそりと…　…　…　つかって　みて　くれたまえ

structure.jp: つかって　みて　くれたまえ

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a verb plus みる means to try doing it and see how it goes. つかって　みて = 'try using it'.

patterns.name: 〜たまえ
patterns.explanation: たまえ is a lordly way for an older man of rank to tell someone below him to do something; with くれる it is 'do this for me'. くれたまえ = 'do (it) for me, if you would'.

patterns.name: 〜と (how)
patterns.explanation: と after a word that describes a way of acting ties it to the action. こっそりと = 'secretly, on the quiet'.
